title: Plant Manager
why_this_account: industry fit (Food Processing); ~400 employees; buyer title (Plant Manager); signal: historian_or_scada; signal: line_expansion
subject_1: sensor data at greenfield example foods
body_1:
Hi Tom,

Greenfield Example Foods already collects sensor data through Scada. Most plants only look at that data after something fails. The same readings usually show drift days or weeks earlier.

I build predictive maintenance models for rotating equipment. Send me an export from one asset class and I show you which failures the model would have flagged, and how early. I have tested the approach on NASA's public turbofan engine data.

Worth testing on one line?

Shabda
subject_2: re: sensor data at greenfield example foods
body_2:
Tom, following up. The pilot needs one asset class and a few months of sensor and failure history. Should I send a short list of what to export?
Shabda
subject_3: re: sensor data at greenfield example foods
body_3:
A thought, Tom: the first output is not a dashboard, it is a ranked list of assets that look unhealthy right now. That is usually enough to judge if the approach is worth continuing.
Shabda
subject_4: re: sensor data at greenfield example foods
body_4:
I will step back here, Tom. If unplanned stops at Greenfield Example Foods become a priority, the pilot offer stays open.
Shabda
